journal_lines: A man with two llamas. Offered something wrapped in cloth. Gave him a ration. He seemed satisfied.
Wandering trader on the road. Swapped a meal for something wrapped. Fair enough.
Strange merchant. His stock made no sense. Traded anyway. No regrets.
Two llamas, one trader, one deal. Lost a ration. Won something else.
He appeared on the path, made an offer, was gone by nightfall.
Whatever he carries makes no logical sense. This trip is consistent with that.
Traded bread for something sealed in wax. No regrets.
He was standing in the rain waiting. Gave him something. He gave something back. We parted well.
The trader's price was strange. The item he offered was stranger. Traded anyway.
Two llamas spitting at each other. One merchant offering nothing I could identify. Traded anyway.
He materialized on the road like he does. Did the trade. He dematerialized.
His stock defies description. One item made sense. Took it.
